name: System X
goal: End-to-end PDF-to-video authoring workflow, including optional script editing and per-scene regeneration.
description: the system helps researchers turn an uploaded academic PDF into a short-form science communication video by generating hook-and-script choices, narrated visual scenes, captions, and an editable attribution screen. Users select and refine the script and regenerate individual scenes before assembling the final video. Actors: model_1 = large language model; model_2 = video generation model; model_3 = text-to-speech model; tool_1 = backend processing routines; tool_2 = video editing and concatenation tool.

processes.name: Generate hooks and scripts
processes.description: After a researcher uploads a PDF paper, model_1 extracts concrete findings, develops and rates engaging hooks, and creates four matching eight-scene script options.
processes.rawExpression:
(paper_1: artifact language)
-> [model_1 extract]
-> (paper_1: artifact language) + (findings_1: artifact language)*
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (paper_1: artifact language) + (story_ideas_1: artifact language)*
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (paper_1: artifact language) + (hooks_1: artifact language)*
-> [model_1 evaluate]
-> (paper_1: artifact language) + (hooks_1: artifact language)* + (hook_ratings_1: evaluation numeric)*
-> [model_1 select]
-> (paper_1: artifact language) + (shortlisted_hooks_1: artifact language)*
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (script_options_1: artifact record)*

processes.name: Choose script and voiceover style
processes.description: When four hook-and-script options appear, the researcher chooses one. model_1 recommends a voiceover tone, which the researcher accepts or customizes, and merges it with the default fast-speaking style.
processes.rawExpression:
(script_options_1: artifact record)*
-> [human select]
-> (script_1: artifact record)
-> [tool_1 compose]
-> (script_1: artifact record) + (baseline_voice_style_1: instruction language)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (script_1: artifact record) + (baseline_voice_style_1: instruction language) + (tone_suggestion_1: instruction language)
-> [human specify]
-> (script_1: artifact record) + (baseline_voice_style_1: instruction language) + (tone_preference_1: instruction language)
-> [model_1 compose]~
-> (script_1: artifact record) + (voice_style_1: instruction language)

processes.name: Refine the script
processes.description: After selecting a script, the researcher can edit its wording in the script editor. The researcher can edit it again at any time, or use the original script unchanged.

processes.name: Prepare storyboard and generate clips
processes.description: After the script and voice style are set, model_1 segments the script and writes visual prompts for its scenes. The researcher generates clips together or individually; a speech model narrates them, model_2 generates timed visuals, and tool_2 combines video, voice and captions.
processes.rawExpression:
(script_1: artifact record) + (voice_style_1: instruction language)
-> [model_1 decompose]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language)
-> [human specify]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_request_1: instruction categorical)
-> [model_3 generate]~
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_audio_1: artifact audio)*
-> [tool_1 extract]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_audio_1: artifact audio)* + (scene_durations_1: artifact numeric)*
-> [model_2 generate]~
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_audio_1: artifact audio)* + (scene_videos_1: artifact visual)*
-> [tool_2 compose]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)*

processes.name: Regenerate a scene
processes.description: After reviewing storyboard clips, the researcher can request another version of any scene. The system produces and replaces that clip; this can repeat until its visuals are satisfactory.
processes.rawExpression:
(scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)*
-> [human select]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (scene_selection_1: selection categorical)
-> [human specify]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (scene_selection_1: selection categorical) + (regeneration_request_1: instruction categorical)
-> [model_3 generate]~
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (scene_selection_1: selection categorical) + (replacement_audio_1: artifact audio)
-> [tool_1 extract]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (scene_selection_1: selection categorical) + (replacement_audio_1: artifact audio) + (replacement_duration_1: artifact numeric)
-> [model_2 generate]~
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (scene_selection_1: selection categorical) + (replacement_audio_1: artifact audio) + (replacement_video_1: artifact visual)
-> [tool_2 compose]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (scene_selection_1: selection categorical) + (replacement_clip_1: artifact multimodal)
-> [tool_1 modify]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)*

processes.name: Revise a storyboard scene
processes.description: After clips have been generated, the researcher can change a scene script. model_1 updates its visual prompt, and the scene is generated again; this can repeat until the scene is satisfactory.
processes.rawExpression:
(scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)*
-> [human modify]
-> (scene_scripts_2: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)*
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (scene_scripts_2: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_2: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)*
-> [model_3 generate]~
-> (scene_scripts_2: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_2: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (revised_audio_1: artifact audio)
-> [tool_1 extract]
-> (scene_scripts_2: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_2: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (revised_audio_1: artifact audio) + (revised_duration_1: artifact numeric)
-> [model_2 generate]~
-> (scene_scripts_2: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_2: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (revised_audio_1: artifact audio) + (revised_video_1: artifact visual)
-> [tool_2 compose]
-> (scene_scripts_2: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_2: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (revised_clip_1: artifact multimodal)
-> [tool_1 modify]
-> (scene_scripts_1: artifact language)* + (visual_prompts_1: instruction language)* + (voice_style_1: instruction language) + (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)*

processes.name: Add credits and merge video
processes.description: After the storyboard clips are complete, the system extracts the paper’s first-page screenshot and author names for an editable credit scene. The researcher edits the attribution, approves scenes and requests the final merge, producing a single MP4 video.
processes.rawExpression:
(scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (paper_1: artifact language)
-> [tool_1 extract]
-> (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (paper_screenshot_1: artifact visual) + (paper_authors_1: artifact language)*
-> [tool_1 compose]
-> (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (paper_screenshot_1: artifact visual) + (credit_text_1: artifact language)
-> [human modify]
-> (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (paper_screenshot_1: artifact visual) + (credit_text_2: artifact language)
-> [tool_1 compose]
-> (scene_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (credit_scene_1: artifact visual)
-> [human select]
-> (approved_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (credit_scene_1: artifact visual)
-> [human specify]
-> (approved_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (credit_scene_1: artifact visual) + (merge_request_1: instruction categorical)
-> [tool_2 translate]
-> (approved_clips_1: artifact multimodal)* + (credit_clip_1: artifact multimodal)
-> [tool_2 compose]
-> (final_video_1: artifact multimodal)

representations.paper: the research paper PDF the researcher uploads
representations.findings: concrete findings extracted from the paper
representations.story_ideas: ideas for telling the paper's story to a general audience
representations.hooks: attention-grabbing opening lines for a short video
representations.hook_ratings: a score for how engaging each hook is
representations.script_options: four script options, each a hook with an eight-scene script
representations.tone_suggestion: a suggested narration tone for this script
representations.tone_preference: the tone the researcher accepts or writes
representations.scene_scripts: the narration text for each scene
representations.visual_prompts: a prompt describing the visuals for each scene
representations.scene_request: a request to generate all scenes or one scene
representations.scene_audio: the narrated voice-over for each scene
representations.scene_durations: the length of each scene's narration
representations.scene_videos: generated video for each scene, timed to its narration
representations.scene_clips: each scene's video combined with voice-over and captions
representations.regeneration_request: a request to generate the picked scene again
representations.replacement_audio: new narration for the picked scene
representations.replacement_duration: the length of the new narration
representations.replacement_video: new video for the picked scene
representations.replacement_clip: the new combined clip for the picked scene
representations.revised_audio: narration for an edited scene script
representations.revised_clip: the combined clip for the edited scene
representations.paper_screenshot: an image of the paper's first page
representations.credit_text: the attribution text for the closing credits
representations.credit_scene: the closing credit screen with the first-page image and attribution
representations.approved_clips: the scene clips the researcher approves
representations.merge_request: the request to merge everything into the final video
representations.credit_clip: the credit screen turned into a video clip
representations.final_video: the finished short vertical video file
